intents.trigger: Initial ~3% tranche only on a confirmed retest of the $113-116 zone requiring stabilization evidence (a close back above $115 or a clear rejection of the zone low), entry near $114.50; add 1-2% tranche only on a decisive close above $121.20 on elevated volume
intents.entry_convention: staged adds on confirmed retest; verify earnings calendar and EDGAR filings before any tranche executes

intents.reevaluation: quantified CSL deal economics or decisive close above $121.20 upgrades toward Buy/Overweight; close below $107, deal-economics disappointment, or adverse rates on the $1.1B 2030 refinancing shifts toward Sell

intents.trigger: (1) confirmed close above ~115.7, ideally post-appeal, at partial size; (2) pullback toward 106-107 on ordinary volume with NO adverse legal news as a starter — kill any plan to buy a news-driven flush to 105.7

intents.ambiguity: the 106-107 pullback trigger is conditioned on 'no adverse legal news', a judgment condition that cannot be confirmed deterministically
